region: Poconos / Northeast Pennsylvania (Pike, Wayne, Monroe, Lackawanna, Luzerne, Lehigh counties)
_evidence_note: reddit.com blocks both the WebSearch user agent and Firecrawl, so thread bodies were not obtainable. Findings below come from (a) search-result titles and roofing-contractor page copy for the Poconos/Monroe County market, which evidence the questions homeowners in this market ask, and (b) MNM's own review corpus and third-party profiles (GuildQuality 4.8/43, Birdeye 4.8/264, BBB A+). Directional, not a read of thread comments.

pain_points.claim: Subcontracted crews are the norm, so the company that sold the job is not the company on the roof — and accountability disappears when something goes wrong.
pain_points.evidence: MNM's own site returns to 'no subcontracting' six separate times across the home, about, residential and commercial pages — a differentiator is only worth repeating that often if the opposite is what customers keep encountering.

pain_points.claim: Storm-chasing outfits appear after weather events, push an insurance claim, and are gone before the warranty matters.
pain_points.evidence: Recurring search-result titles across the PA roofing market: 'What is the risk in using a stormchasing roofing company?', 'Is this roofer trying to rope me into an insurance scam?'

pain_points.claim: Poconos and Lake Wallenpaupack homeowners are frequently second-home or seasonal owners who cannot supervise the work and need documentation they can trust remotely.
pain_points.evidence: MNM's completed-project addresses cluster on Woodloch Drive, Boulder Drive, Clark Drive and Lenape Trail — lake and resort-community roads. MNM's answer is photo-documented projects mapped by address.

pain_points.claim: Homeowners cannot picture what they are buying — shingle line, colour, panel profile — until it is already installed.
pain_points.evidence: MNM built a physical showroom in Greentown with shingle, metal, gutter and colour samples, and pushes clients toward it on two location pages.

pain_points.claim: Being left to argue with the insurance adjuster alone after storm damage.
pain_points.evidence: Local contractor copy across the Poconos market leads with ice dams, wind-driven rain and tree damage; MNM's /resources page is dedicated to storm documentation and claim support.

pain_points.claim: Roof replacement cost is a barrier and financing is opaque.
pain_points.evidence: MNM publishes a full GoodLeap FAQ — rates, terms, limits, payment mechanics — rather than a 'financing available' badge.

what_customers_value: The crew on the roof works for the company that sold the job
A named owner who runs the estimate himself
Warranty length stated in numbers, not adjectives
Someone who documents the damage to the standard the adjuster wants
Being able to see and touch the shingle and the metal panel before choosing
Local offices close enough that a callback is a short drive, not a regional dispatch
business_differentiators: Zero subcontracting — every installer is MNM's own, personally trained by the owner
10-year workmanship warranty plus a 15-year craftsman warranty on full replacements
Miguel Cornejo, the owner, personally oversees every free estimate
Three offices — Greentown, Nanticoke and Whitehall Township — covering the Poconos to the Lehigh Valley
A physical roofing showroom with shingle, metal, gutter and colour samples
BBB accredited with an A+ rating; PA licensed (PA154140), bonded and insured
Every completed project photographed and mapped by address on a public project map
$250 referral rewards, veteran roof giveaways, youth sports sponsorships
BusinessRate 'Best of 2026' award winner for Pike County roofing

copy_angles.angle: Nobody subcontracts your roof — our crew, every time
copy_angles.why: Their single most-repeated claim, and the direct answer to the accountability gap that defines this market. Concrete and checkable.
A number beats an adjective, and it is longer than what a subcontracting competitor can honestly offer.
Puts a name and a face on a purchase homeowners are afraid to make. Verified on BBB as principal contact.

copy_angles.angle: See it before you buy it — visit the Greentown showroom
copy_angles.why: Almost no roofer in NEPA has one. It converts an abstract, high-anxiety spend into a physical decision.

copy_angles.angle: We document the storm damage the way your adjuster needs it
copy_angles.use: storm-damage service page / process step two
copy_angles.why: Turns the scariest part of a claim into a service they perform, and it is the whole point of their /resources page.

copy_angles.angle: Three offices, from the Poconos to the Lehigh Valley
copy_angles.why: Justifies the six area pages honestly — these are real staffed addresses, not invented coverage.

recommended_hero.headline: Your Roof, Our Crew — Never a Subcontractor
recommended_hero.support: Family-owned roofing across Northeast Pennsylvania, from the Poconos to the Lehigh Valley. Every shingle and every panel goes on by MNM's own in-house crew, backed by a 10-year workmanship warranty.
